Plot an LHWPR Tuning Object

plot.tune.lhwpr.Rd

Plot bandwidth and lambda profiles, a joint bandwidth–lambda surface, an exact evaluated-candidate landscape, and an alpha profile for an object returned by tune.lhwpr().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'tune.lhwpr'
plot(
  x,
  type = c(
    "all", "bandwidth", "lambda", "landscape", "surface", "alpha"
  ),
  criterion = NULL,
  alpha = NULL,
  gamma = NULL,
  include_lhwr = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A "tune.lhwpr" object.

type

One of "all", "bandwidth", "lambda", "landscape", "surface", or "alpha".

criterion

Criterion to display. NULL uses the criterion that selected the model.

alpha, gamma

Optional alpha and gamma defining the displayed surface slice. With type = "surface" or type = "landscape" and alpha = NULL, one panel is drawn for each evaluated alpha.

include_lhwr

Whether the same-fold unpenalized LHWR reference is overlaid on the bandwidth profile.

...

Additional graphical arguments passed to profile plots.

Details

The selected tuning point is marked in red. A selected lower or upper bandwidth boundary is annotated in the bandwidth and surface panels. The surface uses relative lambda so configurations whose absolute lambda maxima differ remain comparable.

The landscape plots only evaluated candidates and therefore does not imply interpolation between grid points. Point shapes distinguish coarse and refined stages, grey crosses mark candidates excluded by convergence, KKT, or criterion-specific validity gates, and the selected eligible point is marked separately. Profiles and interpolated surfaces are computed only from eligible candidates.

Value

Invisibly, the data used by the requested plot. For type = "all", a named list containing the four panel data sets is returned; its joint panel is named landscape.

Examples

set.seed(3)
H <- simulate_H2(30, r_max = 1.5)
dat <- data.frame(y = rnorm(30), x = rnorm(30))
selection <- tune.lhwpr(
  y ~ x,
  data = dat,
  Z = H$Z,
  bw_grid = c(14, 20),
  nlambda = 3,
  nfolds = 2,
  refit = FALSE
)
plot(selection, type = "bandwidth")
